name: SLEEPLESS Nocturne
source: Two people, Kawai Tomoki and Komori Yukino, were enjoying their unfamiliar drive date. They are a college couple who have just started dating. When their car broke down due to a flat tire, they left it behind and sought help, eventually arriving at the Black Rose Mansion. Thanks to the bewitching charm of Mamiya Marie, the two are allowed inside the mansion and are overwhelmed by its magnificent and luxurious space. In this mansion, there are four residents including the maid Aira, Marie's beautiful daughter Mamiya Maria, and another girl(?) named Takamizawa Rui who wears a boldly modified maid outfit with a collar, large cat ears, and even a tail-like attachment saying "My name is Takamizawa Rui-nyan!". Tomoki and Yukino, who will be spending a few days in the secluded Western-style mansion, the Black Rose Mansion, do not yet know that they will become prey to the bizarre feast that is about to begin.
translation: 河合智树和小森雪乃两个人正在享受着陌生的驾车约会。他们是一对刚刚开始约会的大学情侣。当他们的车因轮胎漏气而抛锚时，他们把车抛在一边寻求帮助，最终到达了黑玫瑰宅邸。由于间宫玛丽惠的迷人魅力，两人被允许进入宅邸，并被其宏伟而奢华的空间所震撼。这座宅邸里住着四位住户，包括女仆爱良、玛丽艾的漂亮女儿间宫玛丽亚，以及另一个名叫高见泽瑠衣的女孩（？），她穿着经过大胆改造的女仆装，有领子、大大的猫耳朵，甚至还有一个像尾巴一样的附件，上面写着“我的名字是高见泽瑠衣喵！”。即将在幽静的西式宅邸“黑玫瑰宅邸”度过几天的智树和雪乃还不知道自己将成为即将开始的奇异盛宴的牺牲品。
